observations.finding: Convergence is the present bottleneck; another top-level engine would increase contradiction risk.
observations.action: reuse Cycle7/SI-0012/SI-0014 convergence and build only missing story adapters

observations.finding: Typed approval events are first-class production types.
observations.action: keep RESUME, FOUNDER_LOCK, CANON_APPROVAL and RELEASE_APPROVAL non-substitutable

observations.finding: CURRENT routers can contain stale embedded project slices.
observations.action: reuse SI-0015 main implementation and compare every current slice with controlling project state

observations.finding: Story Core laws are strong but unevenly machine-contractual.
observations.action: pilot bounded STORY_CORE_COMPILER before any global promotion

observations.finding: Canon-sensitive UNKNOWN/OPTION is vulnerable to automation filling gaps.
Engineering test count does not prove literary quality or Human Signal.
observations.action: preserve evidence-class firewalls and require real human evidence where specified

observations.finding: Expert knowledge can be incorrectly converted into jurisdiction.
Mystery systems need explicit observation vs interpretation vs non-proof states.
observations.action: pilot MYSTERY_EPISTEMIC_LADDER on a real book only after legitimate project activation

observations.finding: New story adapters risk checklist behavior and false positives.
observations.action: require real-defect target, healthy no-change control, false-positive review and cross-project replication before universal scope
treat Next64 as evidence backlog selected by dependency/information value

observations.finding: Concurrent repo work can advance while a package is being written.
observations.action: fresh-main compare before material write and before merge; salvage unique compatible deltas rather than restart

observations.finding: Bounded meta work must hand control back to product work/real gates.
observations.action: portfolio governor returns to D01 Founder lock decision unless newer controlling authority supersedes
